title: VSift screen change record v1
description: One published screen_change evidence record (changes, ADR 0034): a moment the visual index saw the screen change, the exact frame before and after it, and the rectangles where those two frames differ under the profile screen-change-regions-v1. The frames are ordinary frame_evidence records, listed in the page's frames and delivered in its files. Cite a change by its before and after evidence_id, never by change_id, which handoff check does not know. With changes --crops, each of the change's two largest regions also names the crops cut out of the two frames (before_crop and after_crop, frame_evidence records of kind crop listed in the page's frames). A change says which pixels differ between two frames; it never says what the change means, that nothing else changed, or exactly when it changed (only after change_window.from_us and at or before change_window.to_us). Times are integer microseconds on the normalized source timeline.

change_id.description: The change's identity: a digest of the session, source, stream, index profile, region profile and its candidates, the same on every call.

kind.description: change: one sampled change of screen (a visual_change candidate). motion: a run of three or more changing samples, or part of one.

motion.description: For kind motion, which part of the run the change stands for: run (before it moved, after it settled), start (a motion_start without the candidate that ended its run: after is its first moving frame) or end (a settled_after_motion whose run start the window's budget dropped: before is the last moving frame). null for kind change.

settled.description: For kind motion, whether the after frame is a settled screen (true for run and end, false for start). null for kind change.

candidate_ids.description: The visual candidates the change stands for, in time order: one, or two for a whole motion run.

change_window.description: The index's bracket: the screen changed after the sampled frame at from_us and at or before the one at to_us.

comparison.description: compared: the two frames have the same displayed size and were compared. dimensions_differ: they do not (a stream whose size changes), so nothing was compared and regions is empty.

regions.description: The largest rectangles where the frames differ, by changed_pixels, at most profile.max_regions. Each is the bounding rectangle of joined changed tiles in displayed pixels, clipped to the frame: the space crop --rect takes. With changes --crops, the first two may carry before_crop and after_crop.

changed_area.description: The rectangle around every changed tile, with every changed pixel of them, so nothing is silently lost; null when the frames differ nowhere at the threshold or were not compared.

no_region_at_threshold.description: true when the index saw a change but the two compared frames differ nowhere at the profile's thresholds (a change below them, or slow drift); the change is still listed.

frame.description: One of the change's two frames: an actual decoded frame the index sampled, extracted as frame get extracts it. evidence_id names its frame_evidence record in the page's frames; time_us is its actual time; clock_time is the record's own, absent when the session has no time anchor.

listed_region.description: A listed region: its rectangle and, only with changes --crops, the crops of it. before_crop and after_crop are each present only when that crop was made: the call crops each change's first two regions, before then after, in page order, at most crops.limit a call, and stops early for the session's evidence room, the deadline or a cancellation (crops.stop says which). A crop is the source's own pixels of the rectangle at native size, cut from that frame by crop.

changed_pixels.description: Changed pixels in the rectangle's changed tiles.

before_crop.description: The crop of this rectangle from the before frame: a frame_evidence record of kind crop whose parent is before.evidence_id.

after_crop.description: The crop of this rectangle from the after frame: a frame_evidence record of kind crop whose parent is after.evidence_id.

changed_pixels.description: Changed pixels in the rectangle's changed tiles.
